change: Extract from the Saudi Exchange XBRL renderings first, then locate every figure in the PDF for a page reference.
reason: The archive holds an XBRL .xls for nearly every filing, with entity, period, currency and rounding embedded, which makes company/period/unit verification mechanical. PDFs remain the primary document for page references and notes.

change: Choose the 'latest restated' value by the period a document covers, not by its filing date.
reason: ANB re-filed several 2022–2023 XBRL files in 2025; ordering by filing date would have picked a re-filed old interim over the next annual report.

change: Cross-check every value across all documents that present it and flag differences above 0.5% as restatement or unit error.
reason: Found a unit-declaration error (Petro Rabigh Q2 2023 XBRL declared 'Actuals' for thousands) and real restatements (Petro Rabigh FY2024 revenue; FY2024 bank equity restated in 9M 2025 interims).

change: Classify bank income-statement lines by position (above 'Total operating income' / inside 'Total operating expenses') rather than by label alone.
reason: Fee lines switch between net and gross+expense presentations, impairments sit inside operating expenses, and some 'other operating expenses' are deductions within operating income.

change: Keep an overrides register for XBRL gaps and mis-tags, each with PDF page and reason.
reason: ADES 9M 2026 has no XBRL; ANB FY2024 XBRL is unreadable; Al Rajhi's FY2022 comparative in the FY2023 XBRL tags FX income as a fee line.

change: Re-save malformed .xls files through LibreOffice before declaring them unreadable.
reason: 11 bank annual XBRL files failed the standard reader; 10 were recovered this way.

change: Flag scanned PDFs (no text layer) in the source register and verify their figures visually.
reason: 73 PDFs in the two pilot sectors have no extractable text on the first pages (e.g. Bahri primary statements, many bank interims).

change: Calculate operating income consistently for 'nature of expense' income statements (PBT + finance costs − finance income − share of associates) and label it C.
reason: Aramco and SARCO do not present an operating-profit line; without this, sector operating income and EBITDA would mix definitions.

change: Show company-specific top-line items (e.g. Aramco's other income related to sales) separately and keep them out of the sector top line.
reason: Keeps sector revenue on one IFRS definition while preserving Aramco's own presentation.

change: Treat growth on a zero or negative base as 'n.m.' everywhere, including sector totals excluding the largest company.
reason: Energy excluding Aramco is loss-making in FY2023–FY2025, so percentage growth is meaningless there; absolute changes are shown instead.

change: Use interim-report management pages for operating KPIs where annual PDFs carry only financial statements.
reason: Aramco's interim reports include realised price and production, which allow a price/volume split for 9M; the annual files in the archive do not.

change: Check the archive's sector folders against the Saudi Exchange classification before aggregating.
reason: Aldrees (4200) and Luberef (2223) sit outside the archive's Energy folder; sector totals depend on this choice and must state it.

change: Exclude archive files whose names mark them STALE / DO-NOT-USE or UNKNOWN-PERIOD, and log the exclusion.
reason: Present in Capital Goods, Consumer Services, Food & Beverages, Health Care, Insurance and Materials folders (not in the two pilots).

change: Separate 'investment holding' companies with no revenue (e.g. SARCO) from revenue-based ratios and growth.
reason: SARCO reports no revenue; revenue-based margins are not meaningful and it is shown on a profit basis only.

change: For banks, build ROE on ordinary equity (excluding Tier 1 sukuk, after Tier 1 distributions) and keep bank-reported ROE as reference only.
reason: Tier 1 sukuk are classified in equity and their size differs widely between banks; reported ROE definitions differ.
